text_block_list.text: —I want Mejiro Ramonu to master the mile races.

Those expectations are the Oka Sho, the Yasuda Kinen,
the Mile Championship, the Victoria Mile—

With such decisive victories in those races,
she answered that call.
choice_data_list: (A great record that will go down in racing history!)

text_block_list.text: When I told Mejiro Ramonu about that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

Mejiro Ramonu runs supreme races,
and winning them is her ultimate love.
She is not fixated on records themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You take pride
in that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then,
it calls for a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I shall extend invitations
to fitting guests."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure...
it'll be a wonderful time...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
âRamonu-chan,
over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen.
Good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo, good day to you!
It's a totally stellar, crystal-clear sunny day, isn't it?♪

The one Mejiro Ramonu called out to was Maruzensky.
They're in the same class, so it's natural they'd have interactions, but...

Maruzensky... She too is an Umamusume
with a legendary record. In the Junior-class
'Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes'—

She recorded an unprecedented track record. What's more,
it was an overwhelming blowout victory. Even after that, she won
every race she entered, running with speed that was almost—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, which of you is gonna ride in my
"supercar"... Tacchan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
We're going for a drive, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-chan said she wants to see my car...
Trainer, did you hear anything from Florence Nightin-get-it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then you didn't ask directions on your way here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-chan... You're quite the secretive one,
even with your Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
You too... right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that mischievous look on your face.
Do you have a surprise for me?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this date is going to be even more fun!
Well then, Ramonu-chan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No, the one who will be riding Tacchan
is you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'll have my family car
give me a ride home."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪
Hop right on, Trainer!

And so,
for some reason, I ended up going for a drive in Maruzensky's supercar, but...
(Skrrrrt! Screeech screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whew!
Niiice technique!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! Tacchan's in top form too!
Let's keep this momentum going full throttle~~!!
choice_data_list: (S-She's this much of a speed freak...!)

text_block_list.text:
Why did Mejiro Ramonu desire a supercar herself, yet put me in Tac-chan?
I don't understand anything... but for now...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
What a nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, and here I was sure I'd be faster!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You must have made a detour along the way.
After all, I came straight here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... Fufufu.
Please do not make such a resentful face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And here I let you taste the speed of a "Supercar" before facing me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Before me"... so that means you're next, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: “—On the turf... is where I feel who I truly am...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—I have come to claim
the true pinnacle of the mile.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ah, you're the best, Ramonu-chan! Our fun date is just getting started, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
You mustn't blink.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because everything
is fleeting—

An unofficial showdown with the "Supercar" to decide
the true Mile King... I watched over this lavish battle
that would never be recorded in history—
